description: Embedded per-feature (or per-biosample) min/max expression extrema for one matrix, attached as info.expressionSummary on feature/biosample records from feature_expression_stats / biosample_expression_stats parquet. Not a standalone Beacon entry-type endpoint. Feature rows may include minBiosampleId/maxBiosampleId; biosample rows may include minFeatureId/maxFeatureId.

min.description: Minimum expression value observed for this feature or biosample in the matrix.

max.description: Maximum expression value observed for this feature or biosample in the matrix.

minBiosampleId.description: Biosample id holding the minimum (feature-axis embed only).

maxBiosampleId.description: Biosample id holding the maximum (feature-axis embed only).

minFeatureId.description: Feature id holding the minimum (biosample-axis embed only).

maxFeatureId.description: Feature id holding the maximum (biosample-axis embed only).
